atten2.ptxt: Some of these service operations affect the SRS airbag system, so be sure to read the precautions for the SRS airbag system before starting work. (see )

atten4.ptxt: For the procedure up to removal of the horn button assembly, refer to .

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Airbag Assembly Lower NO.1

atten4.ptxt: For the procedure up to removal of the instrument panel airbag assembly LWR No.1, refer to .

s2.ptxt: Operate the tilt and telescopic mechanisms to fix the steering column assembly in its fully extended and fully raised position.
Remove the nut and put matchmarks on the steering wheel assembly and steering column assembly.
Using SST, remove the steering wheel assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Apply a small amount of grease to the threads and tip of the SST center bolt (09953-05020) before use.
If the removal procedure is incorrect, the claws may be damaged.

s2.ptxt: Release the tilt lever.
Push the steering column cover (lower side) from the left and right to disengage the 4 claws.
Insert a finger through the tilt lever opening of the steering column cover (lower side) and disengage the claw.

atten4.ptxt: Open the claw to disengage it.

s2.ptxt: As shown in the illustration, insert a flat-tipped screwdriver wrapped with protective tape into the 2 service holes of the steering column cover (lower side), disengage the 2 claws and remove the steering column cover (lower side).

atten3.ptxt: Wrap the flat-tipped screwdriver with protective tape to avoid damaging the steering column lower cover.

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 2 claws and pins, and remove the steering column cover (upper side).

s-1.ptxt: Remove Turn Signal Switch Assembly w/ Spiral Cable

s2.ptxt: Disconnect each connector from the turn signal switch assembly w/ spiral cable.
Using pliers, loosen the clamp.
With the clamp loosened, disengage the claws using a flat-tipped screwdriver, and remove the turn signal switch assembly w/ spiral cable from the steering column assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Upper w/ Instrument Panel Passenger Airbag Assembly

atten4.ptxt: For the procedure up to removal of the instrument panel UPR with instrument panel passenger airbag assembly, refer to .

s-1.ptxt: Remove Column Hole Cover Silencer Sheet

s2.ptxt: Turn back the floor carpet, remove the 2 clips, and remove the column hole cover silencer sheet.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Steering Intermediate Shaft Assembly NO.2

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt from steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2.
Slide steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2 toward the steering column assembly until the serrations of the steering intermediate shaft are visible.

atten3.ptxt: Do not disconnect steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2 from the steering intermediate shaft.

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2 and the steering intermediate shaft.
Disconnect steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2 from the steering intermediate shaft.
Turn the stop light switch assembly 1/4 turn and remove it.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Stop Light Switch Mounting Adjuster

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 2 claws and remove the stop light switch mounting adjuster.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Steering Column Assembly w/ Steering Intermediate Shaft Assembly NO.2

s2.ptxt: Detach the wire harness clamp from the power steering computer assembly.
Disconnect the connector from the power steering computer assembly.

atten4.ptxt: As shown in the illustration, pull out the lock lever lock, then lower the lock lever and disconnect the connector.

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector from the power steering computer assembly.
Disconnect each connector and detach the wire harness clamps from the steering column assembly.
Remove the 2 bolts and nuts, and remove the steering column assembly w/ steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2.

atten3.ptxt: Do not subject the steering column assembly (especially the motor and torque sensor) to impacts. If it has been subjected to a severe impact (such as being struck or dropped on the floor), replace it with a new part.
